lines.text: Peter and John go to the temple at the ninth hour, and a lame man asks them for money.
Peter tells the lame man to walk in Jesus' name, and he goes into the Pool of Siloam leaping.
The people recognize the man as the beggar and run to Peter and John in David's Colonnade.
Peter says the people rejected Jesus before Pilate, asked for a murderer, and killed the Author of life.
Peter says Moses foretold a prophet like him, and God sent His Servant first to the crowd to bless them.
